en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, from Ismail Bin Riyah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I asked himasws about the performer of the exclusive Umra, ‘Is there Tawaaf Al-Nisa upon him?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of our people from ‘Isma‘il ibn Rabah who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who performs just al-‘Umrah; if he is required to perform Tawaf al-Nisa’.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, he is required to do so.’”
